galaxy_ship.bed.no_sleep_on_station: Your spawn point is set. There's no night to sleep through in space
galaxy_ship.welcome: Welcome to the station! The galaxy is below: jump off the plank walkway to dive into it. To come back, find a blue Homeward Bloom on a planet.
galaxy_ship.no_building: You can't build or break anything on the station
galaxy_ship.entered: You dove into galaxy %s and drifted down to a %s planet. Blue Homeward Blooms on other planets throw you back up to the station.
galaxy_ship.no_galaxy: The galaxy dimension isn't loaded. Is Galaxy Generation installed on the server?
galaxy_ship.homeward: The Homeward Bloom carried you back to the station
